امتعضتم (form VIII)
# اِمْتَعَضْتُمْ (imtaʕaḍtum) /im.ta.ʕadˤ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اُمْتُعِضْتُمْ (umtuʕiḍtum) /um.tu.ʕidˤ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
